rows.label: Vox Solaris
rows.note: unlocks Rude Zuud and Solaris United standing

conditions: Whether Rude Zuud requires the quest before selling Gaze specifically wasn't confirmed, but every other Solaris United vendor gate does.

groups.activity: bounties and Ticker trades toward Doer

rows.label: Debt-Bonds
rows.note: Training, Shelter and Medical bonds; exact counts per rank not itemized here
rows.alt: Ticker sells cheap Training/Shelter bonds for credits and materials

rows.label: Shelter Debt-Bond
rows.note: spent again at the gild, separate from rank-up costs

conditions: Exploiter Orb (Deck 12, needs Diluted Thermia) drops a pile of trade-in gems worth a day's standing in one squad run.
bonuses: Conservation (Kubrodon, Bolarola, Stover) is the fastest standing route to Doer.

groups.activity: buy chamber, grip and loader blueprints

rows.label: Slap Blueprint
rows.note: loader, Rank 0; standing cost not confirmed in sources

conditions: Grip and loader give no Mastery. Splat is the community's real-build loader, but it needs Cove (Rank 4) and can wait.

groups.sub: caves for Tepa, The Business for fish, any Excavation for Cryotic

rows.label: Tepa Nodule
rows.note: glowing plant clusters in Vallis caves; also bounty rewards

rows.label: Venerdo Alloy
rows.note: refine from Venerol ore; needs two crafts of the reusable blueprint

rows.label: Kriller Thermal Laser
rows.note: 1 per Kriller servofish, Vallis lakes, Warm weather only

conditions: Venerdo Alloy's reusable blueprint costs 2,000 standing from Smokefinger, Rank 1 (Outworlder); each craft yields 20, so this chamber needs two crafts.
Kriller only spawns during the Vallis's short Warm cycle (a few minutes out of every ~26); each fish gives exactly one laser regardless of size, so plan for 40 catches across several Warm windows.

groups.activity: build, assemble, level, gild, level again

rows.label: gild at rank 30
rows.note: Doer rank, 10 Shelter Debt-Bonds, 5,000 credits; resets it to rank 0

conditions: An ungilded Kitgun earns no Mastery no matter how far it's levelled. Level to 30, gild, then level to 30 again.
Only one Gaze ever counts for Mastery; primary and secondary share the entry.

disclosures.title: the beam ammo cut
disclosures.body: Update 32.0 cut Gaze's ammo pool to 200. If you build one to actually use, most players call Pax Charge close to mandatory.
